videos.author: @stcharlos
videos.description: Such a bum #onepiece #agendapiece #viral #slander #kizaru Kizaru might genuinely be the greatest larper in One Piece because this man has somehow convinced half the fanbase that being made of light automatically means he is secretly some untouchable god tier when almost every time he actually has to do something important he starts moving like a man who just remembered he left his wallet at home. Bro has the Pika Pika no Mi, can literally turn into light, fires lasers, teleports around, has one of the most broken movement abilities in the entire series and yet somehow uses all of this power mainly to arrive somewhere, say “oooh scaryyy” and then do the bare minimum required by his employment contract. The funniest part is the way Kizaru acts permanently confused despite being an Admiral. Every single situation is apparently shocking to him. A pirate blocks his attack? “Oooh, scary.” Someone uses haki? “Oooh, scary.” Rayleigh breathes in his general direction? Bro immediately starts acting like he just encountered an ancient evil. You are literally one of the highest ranking fighters in the Marines. Why are you constantly roleplaying as a civilian who accidentally walked into the wrong neighbourhood? His entire aura is built on looking relaxed while never actually proving how relaxed he is. Kizaru fans see him put his hands in his pockets and assume this means he is holding back 97% of his power. Maybe he just likes pockets. Maybe bro genuinely does not know where else to put his hands. Apparently every time Kizaru fails to dominate somebody it is because he “wasn’t serious,” which is extremely convenient because this man has apparently not been serious once in 1000 chapters. At some point that stops being mysterious and starts becoming unemployment. Then there is the speed agenda. People talk about Kizaru like he should be instantly crossing entire islands and deleting everyone before their neurons even fire because “he is literally light speed.” Okay then why does every fight involving this man still somehow have enough time for full conversations, reaction panels and people physically moving out of the way? Kizaru will announce that he is about to attack, turn into several glowing particles, travel in a perfectly visible straight line, reform, adjust his tie, ask whether you are scared and THEN kick. This is not light speed. This is a PowerPoint transition. His performance at Marineford was peak larping. This was supposedly a war that could decide the balance of the entire world and Kizaru spent half of it looking like he had accidentally been scheduled for a shift on his day off. Whitebeard is right there. Marco is right there. Luffy is sprinting directly toward the execution platform. Kizaru has one of the fastest fruits ever created and still manages to participate like a substitute teacher who has been specifically instructed not to get involved in any incidents. And then people use his clashes with top tiers as proof he belongs in every Yonko debate. Bro, exchanging three attacks with somebody and then looking mildly surprised is not a feat. That is networking. Rayleigh stopped him once and Kizaru fans have been living off the fact that Kizaru did not immediately explode ever since. He fought Marco for a bit and suddenly we are discussing “Admiral portrayal.” Half this man’s scaling is literally based on him standing next to strong people without dying. Egghead might be the greatest example because Kizaru finally gets dragged into a situation where everyone expects him to show this mythical hidden level and he still spends half the arc emotionally buffering. Luffy hits him and suddenly we get ten weeks of people explaining that actually Kizaru being on the floor proves he was mentally conflicted, tired, hungry, emotionally compromised, under orders, spiritually disconnected and possibly suffering from seasonal allergies. There is always something. This man does not fight people. He auditions against them.

videos.author: @aianimecrew
videos.description: #onepiece #kizaru #agendapiece #slander #anime Kizaru genuinely might be the most overqualified employee in the history of the Marines. This mf possesses the power of light, can travel at literal light speed, casually destroys buildings and has enough destructive capability to turn an entire island into a historical document, yet somehow spends his entire working day looking like he's waiting for his lunch break. 😭 Imagine being Fleet Admiral and having an employee capable of arriving at any emergency before the emergency actually happens, only for him to show up 3 business hours later asking if anyone has seen his sunglasses. Bro is literally made of light but communicates at the speed of a Windows 98 loading screen. The funniest part is that whenever Kizaru actually gets serious, everybody suddenly remembers this mf is one of the most terrifying Marines alive, but until that moment he's moving around like an uncle who got dragged to a family gathering against his will. Akainu is probably sitting in his office dealing with 700 pages of paperwork while Kizaru is out here completing missions with the enthusiasm of somebody being asked to cover an extra shift. Imagine getting paid an Admiral salary, having one of the most broken Devil Fruits in existence and still treating every assignment like a mildly inconvenient commute. This man could literally finish his entire workload before breakfast yet somehow manages to make every interaction feel like he's waiting for somebody else to clock out first. Even the Pacifistas probably have more urgency in their programming. At this point the Marines don't need to recruit more soldiers, they need to install a productivity update into Kizaru's brain. (bro has infinite speed and zero urgency)

mentions.title: Such a bum #onepiece #agendapiece #viral #slander #kizaru Kizaru might genuinely be the greatest larper in One Piece because this man has somehow convinced half the fanbase that being made of light automatically means he is secretly some untouchable god tier when almost every time he actually has to do something important he starts moving like a man who just remembered he left his wallet at home. Bro has the Pika Pika no Mi, can literally turn into light, fires lasers, teleports around, has one of the most broken movement abilities in the entire series and yet somehow uses all of this power mainly to arrive somewhere, say “oooh scaryyy” and then do the bare minimum required by his employment contract. The funniest part is the way Kizaru acts permanently confused despite being an Admiral. Every single situation is apparently shocking to him. A pirate blocks his attack? “Oooh, scary.” Someone uses haki? “Oooh, scary.” Rayleigh breathes in his general direction? Bro immediately starts acting like he just encountered an ancient evil. You are literally one of the highest ranking fighters in the Marines. Why are you constantly roleplaying as a civilian who accidentally walked into the wrong neighbourhood? His entire aura is built on looking relaxed while never actually proving how relaxed he is. Kizaru fans see him put his hands in his pockets and assume this means he is holding back 97% of his power. Maybe he just likes pockets. Maybe bro genuinely does not know where else to put his hands. Apparently every time Kizaru fails to dominate somebody it is because he “wasn’t serious,” which is extremely convenient because this man has apparently not been serious once in 1000 chapters. At some point that stops being mysterious and starts becoming unemployment. Then there is the speed agenda. People talk about Kizaru like he should be instantly crossing entire islands and deleting everyone before their neurons even fire because “he is literally light speed.” Okay then why does every fight involving this man still somehow have enough time for full conversations, reaction panels and people physically moving out of the way? Kizaru will announce that he is about to attack, turn into several glowing particles, travel in a perfectly visible straight line, reform, adjust his tie, ask whether you are scared and THEN kick. This is not light speed. This is a PowerPoint transition. His performance at Marineford was peak larping. This was supposedly a war that could decide the balance of the entire world and Kizaru spent half of it looking like he had accidentally been scheduled for a shift on his day off. Whitebeard is right there. Marco is right there. Luffy is sprinting directly toward the execution platform. Kizaru has one of the fastest fruits ever created and still manages to participate like a substitute teacher who has been specifically instructed not to get involved in any incidents. And then people use his clashes with top tiers as proof he belongs in every Yonko debate. Bro, exchanging three attacks with somebody and then looking mildly surprised is not a feat. That is networking. Rayleigh stopped him once and Kizaru fans have been living off the fact that Kizaru did not immediately explode ever since. He fought Marco for a bit and suddenly we are discussing “Admiral portrayal.” Half this man’s scaling is literally based on him standing next to strong people without dying. Egghead might be the greatest example because Kizaru finally gets dragged into a situation where everyone expects him to show this mythical hidden level and he still spends half the arc emotionally buffering. Luffy hits him and suddenly we get ten weeks of people explaining that actually Kizaru being on the floor proves he was mentally conflicted, tired, hungry, emotionally compromised, under orders, spiritually disconnected and possibly suffering from seasonal allergies. There is always something. This man does not fight people. He auditions against them.
